bead.title: Fix blocking postgres wrapper construction
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The postgres composition root still needs a blocking-safe wrapper for the composed backend, and the wrong constructor seam can surface an `E0308` under the release matrix.
ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:983-1005` constructs the postgres backend and immediately wraps it, while `crates/pqueue-server/src/postgres_native.rs:70-82` exposes `BlockingBackend::from_arc` for an already-constructed shared backend; that seam is where the `BlockingBackend::from_arc` mismatch showed up.
PROPOSED FIX: thread the composed postgres backend through the `Arc`-based blocking wrapper path, keep the sync client confined off the reactor, and cover the construction path with a focused compile/runtime test.
NON-SCOPE: CI workflow edits, release alerting, sqlite historical-read wiring, and unrelated formatting/clippy cleanup.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestBlockingBackendFromArcCompiles: the postgres wrapper path compiles when the composed backend is handed through the Arc-based constructor seam.
2. TestBlockingBackendKeepsReactorIsolation: sync postgres work still runs only under `spawn_blocking` or an equivalent non-reactor thread boundary.
3. TestGoTestGate: `go test ./...` passes.
4. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
